# AI-GEO Kit

> Generate a repo AI/GEO surface — llms.txt, robots.txt (AI crawlers opted in), sitemap.xml and schema.org JSON-LD — from its metadata, so AI answer-engines find and cite it. Witness-gated.

AI-GEO Kit is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.

## Key pages

- [Live page](https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/ai-geo-kit/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/ai-geo-kit)
- [The estate](https://www.ai-nativesolutions.com/)

## Verify, don't trust

The estate's rule is proof over promise, and it applies to this summary too. Every claim here is checkable, not asked on trust:

- Continuous integration — the tests and the deterministic mutation gate run on GitHub's own runner: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/ai-geo-kit/actions
- The live page, open and inspectable in the browser: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/ai-geo-kit/
- The full source, MIT-licensed and forkable: https://github.com/sjgant80-hub/ai-geo-kit
